results.name: create, edit, refresh, cancel deletion and delete own update
denied edit preserves editor and denied deletion preserves confirmation
other authors and unverifiable legacy updates are read only
concurrent edits reject stale text without losing either version
atomic routine failure rolls back completion and retry preserves original creator
missing RPC fails closed without legacy writes
reminder appends once and network-aborted status does not persist
two participants accept without updated_at using one RPC each
day, week and month selection retain event identity
initial query failure is visible and reload recovers
deleted remote note draft can be recovered as a new private note
storage quota and failed autosave keep the editor honest
browser context restart recovers pending draft without storing credentials in artifacts
failed outbox survives reload and retries the same ID once
lost acknowledgement reconciles confirmed row on reload
emoji, reply, message search and delete preserve other messages
image and attachment failures recover without deleting referenced objects
member mutations merge latest state and retain last administrator
pending Auth identity survives refresh and profile retry does not sign up again
role changes persist and own privilege controls are disabled
permission role change and individual exception persist
delete disposable profile preserves shared Auth identity in mock
transcript and ZIP export contain fixture content and deleted markers
global retention purges old fixture messages and preserves recent ones
blocked identity mounts no task data and isolated SSO is disabled
reconnection fetches messages missed while socket was disconnected
delayed response from prior channel cannot contaminate current thread
concurrent group invitations preserve both added members
image upload persists media path and file message retry reuses upload
manager cannot change global permissions or administrator role
channel deletion is one operation and rolls back children when denied
group history purge preserves channel and other channel messages
logout and second user login do not display prior outbox or notes
